features: **Custom accent colors** - Choose any **accent color** with a live preview
**Adjustable layout** - Resize **chat and chatbox widths** for better readability (**widescreen** support)
**Typography control** - Customize **font family**, **size**, **line height**, and **letter spacing**
**Chat bubbles** - Toggle **message bubbles** for better message distinction
**Expand prompt box** - Increase the **height of the chatbox** for more typing room
